of two capacitors C<sub>1</sub> and C<sub>2</sub> is 10 μF. When
these capacitors are individually connected to
a voltage source of 1V, the energy stored in the
capacitor C<sub>2</sub> is 4 times that of C<sub>1</sub>. If these
capacitors are connected in series, their
effective capacitance will be :
en.explanation:
C1 + C2 = 10 ......(1)



C2 = 4C1 .....(2)

From (1) ans (2),

C1 = 2 and C2 = 8

For series combination

en.content:
A thermodynamic cycle xyzx is shown on a V-T diagram. The P-V diagram that best describes this cycle is :
(Diagrams are schematic and not to scale)
en.explanation:
From the corresponding V-T graph

Process x y is Isobaric expansion (pressure = constant )

Process y z is Isochoric (volume = constant)

Process z x is Isothermal compression (temperature = constant)

Therefore, (A) is correct P-V graph.
